post.title: The network bottleneck hiding behind GPU utilization
post.content: The silent bottleneck in most AI infrastructure isn't the GPU itself — it's the network path that feeds it. When gradient synchronization, KV cache fetching, or model weight distribution hits a bandwidth ceiling, adding more compute doesn't help.
